description: Browser-based webpage screenshot capture tool. Captures high-resolution JPEG or PNG screenshots of public webpages using isolated headless Chromium with configurable desktop/mobile viewport and optional full-page capture.

dismiss_cookies.description: Attempt to dismiss cookie/GDPR banners before capture.
dismiss_cookies.title: Dismiss Cookies

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page height up to 4000px.
full_page.title: Full Page

scroll.description: Scroll down to trigger lazy-loaded content before capture.
scroll.title: Scroll

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of a webpage to capture as a screenshot.
url.title: Url

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before capture.
wait_for_selector.title: Wait For Selector

wait_ms.description: Optional extra wait in milliseconds (0-5000) before capture.
wait_ms.title: Wait Ms

name: screenshot_webpage
